text:
Alex_Sales: Quick sync — closed Kite Labs (Enterprise, 20 seats). Passing to CS for onboarding and to eng/support for infra/SSO. High-level notes + blockers below.

Priya_CS: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the contract start + go-live target and any hard requirements?

Alex_Sales: Contract start 2025-11-01. Customer wants pilot go-live week of 2025-11-17, then full rollout by end of Q1 2026. Important constraints:
- Must be a VPC Private deployment (on their AWS account)
- SSO: Okta SAML required (enterprise SCIM later)
- Model pinning: want stable low-cost variant for user-facing chat (redwood-3b-quant)
- Bulk embeddings service for search (daily batches)

Mateo_CSE: Noted. Do we have SAML metadata + org admin contact?

Alex_Sales: Okta admin is sara.kite@example.com. They said they will share metadata but haven't yet. Also asked for IP allowlist for egress and an SLA for latency <300ms for chat.

Priya_CS: Risk flags: no SAML metadata yet, VPC peering/network requests typically take 2-3 weeks, dedicated infra lead needed. Renewal risk if pilot misses go-live. I'll own onboarding but need eng & support owners.

Jordan_Support: I'll own the escalation path + runbooks. Can someone create an infra ticket with details (VPC CIDR, peer target, expected traffic)?

Lila_Eng: I can prep the infra runbook and identify required templates for private deploy and peering. Need the CIDR and expected qps for batching vs interactive.

Alex_Sales: Quick numbers from customer: 120 QPS peak for chat during business hours, daily embedding jobs ~5M rows, batch window midnight-4am. VPC CIDR to be confirmed by their infra team.

Claire_CS: I'll schedule two enablement sessions: one for CS admins (product flows + observability) and one for their SREs (networking, peering, firewall). Prefer dates week of 11/10 — good?

Priya_CS: Yes, aim for 11/10 for enablement pre-pilot. Action owners + deadlines: 
- Priya_CS: Onboarding lead, compile kickoff doc + success metrics (due 2025-10-27)
- Lila_Eng: Create infra ticket for VPC peering + private deploy checklist (create by 2025-10-20)
- Mateo_CSE: SCIM/SSO config and sample templates, follow up with Okta admin (reach out by 2025-10-18)
- Jordan_Support: Draft escalation runbook and monitoring alerts (draft by 2025-11-05)
- Claire_CS: Schedule enablement sessions and send invites (by 2025-10-30)

Mateo_CSE: I'll reach out to sara.kite today and ask for the SAML metadata + a pre-signed S3 for log ingestion.

Alex_Sales: Customer also requested model pinning and a fallback plan if redwood-3b-quant runs out of capacity (prefer auto-fallback to redwood-3b-fp16). Please include routing policy in the deploy config.

Lila_Eng: Noted. I'll add routing policy + canary rollout plan to the infra ticket. Need confirmation on allowed egress IPs for their firewall.

Priya_CS: Alex — can you nudge Sara for the SAML metadata and their network contact?

Alex_Sales: Pinged her earlier today, just followed up again. Will post metadata here once received.

deploybot: Created ticket INFRA-7421 for Kite Labs private deployment (assignee: unassigned).

Jordan_Support: @deploybot can you also create a support runbook ticket?

deploybot: Created ticket SUPPORT-3187 for escalation runbook (assignee: Jordan_Support).

Claire_CS: Quick checklist I'm adding to the kickoff doc:
- Success metrics: latency SLO <300ms P95, embedding freshness within 24h, 99.5% availability for pilot
- Data handling: no tenant data stored outside their VPC, logs forwarded to their S3
- Training: 2 sessions + recordings
- Post-pilot review: metric baseline + renewal readiness (owner: Priya_CS)

Priya_CS: Adding renewal note: contract auto-renews unless usage targets met; if pilot underperforms we may need Q1 extension and exec sponsorship. Flagging as medium risk.

Mateo_CSE: Sharing a minimal SAML metadata snippet customers can paste into Okta (ask them for full XML):

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood-inference.example/saml">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <SingleSignOnService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-Redirect" Location="https://idp.example/sso"/>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Lila_Eng: I'll include required IP egress list in INFRA-7421. Typical dev cluster egress: 35.208.12.0/24, 34.122.0.0/16 (will confirm).

Alex_Sales: Thanks all. Please ACK when you have owners assigned and deadlines confirmed. I'll update customer with our internal owners once Priya confirms.

Priya_CS: ACK — I'll own kickoff doc and assign internal owners by EOD 2025-10-18.

Jordan_Support: ACK — will draft runbook and link SUPPORT-3187 to INFRA-7421 once created.

Mateo_CSE: ACK — reaching out to Sara now.

Lila_Eng: ACK — will create infra ticket by 10/20 and add routing/canary notes.

Claire_CS: ACK — scheduling enablement and will share calendar invites by 10/30.

Alex_Sales: Appreciate it. Leaving this thread open for updates; please paste any files/metadata here so we have a single source. :thumbsup:
